subject: Scaling Computer Vision at Volvo | Encord intro
text:
Hi [NAME],

I came across the great work you've been doing in Computer Vision at Volvo.
Have been working with a couple computer vision teams in the ADAS space
more notably for curation (we also do annotation and model eval). We
actually recently onboarded Woven, so thought it may make sense to reach
out to see if we can help at Volvo in a similar way.

Woven's Computer Vision team faced challenges with existing data curation
solutions (Voxel51 & internal tools), which lacked the speed & scalability
required to efficiently search through their training datasets (capping out
at ~1m images).

At Encord, we've built a high-performance architecture to support indexing
and searching through billions of data items (using embeddings
visualisations, quality metric filters & natural language searches),
enabling CV teams to avoid bottlenecks in model development.

Open to learning more?

subject: [NAME], saw the article in Insider Sport - a conversation?
text:
Hi [NAME],

I saw the article from Feb 3rd in Insider Sport and wanted to specifically
reach out to you. (You might see my LinkedIn connect too.)

I'm [SENDER] - the team and I work with a lot of global teams on the
pain points of leveraging Computer Vision in sports analytics, particularly
around things like dynamic classifications.

We work with folks like Hudl, Veo, Spiideo & MVP - a big focus on sports video
use cases.

Our platform offers:

   - *Native Video Editor*: Apply and extrapolate (no need to apply to
   individual frames) as well as allowing for multi-frame object detection.
   Massively reducing annotation time.
   - *Infinite nesting & dynamic classifications*: track physical through
   frames such as walking, jogging, running and jumping.
   - *Key moment identification*: uncover unique periods and edge cases in
   matches and training data automatically.

I wanted to ask if you and the team would be up for a chat?

I think there could be some valuable opportunities to explore your training
data pipelines for your Computer Vision Model Development.

subject: AI roadmap
text:

Congratulations on the recent Series A, was excited to read about your plans to further investment in AI video analytics, so thought it might make sense to introduce Encord, to see if there was a good fit for your [YEAR] roadmap. 

We work with over 70 CTOs of Video AI teams (including LiveView Technologies, Actuate, & Rhombus) who were frustrated with labelling video frame-by-frame using basic annotation tools (e.g. CVAT / in-house solutions).

Encord streamlines this process by supporting native video annotation, typically delivering a 5-10x improvement in annotation speed.: [LINK]

Open to learning more?
